soldier_melee.source: actual runtime reviewed soldier ordinary attack; gallery source action professions-class-6-ally-battle--original_class_6_normal
soldier_melee.reason: Empty palm has shorter reach than the soldier spear; retain approach/strike/recovery/return phases and align contact with visible defender.

evidence.meaning: Normal hit sets hit feedback to 0.5s, plays hit SFX, dispatches hit reaction, then counts HP down.
Damage feedback dims the same actor silhouette; source reaction also records tint/shake.
28 frames, only source pose 12; tint alternates 0.35/1, source horizontal displacements 3,1,2,1,...; no sequential body recoil poses.

hit_feedback.conclusion: A fixed pose with brightness flashing, small displacement and sound is the correct ordinary-damage treatment. Earlier water-monkey flinch poses are no longer used for ordinary hit feedback.
hit_feedback.sound: Existing rm_sfx_03.ogg reused in review as assets/hit.ogg; user-controlled, default muted.

scale.rule: Same ground line, no action-dependent global zoom or resizing in full-scene comparison.

water.rejected: Earlier tight-margin effect atlas was rejected and deleted with user authorization on 2026-11-04; mixed source sheets containing approved poses remain isolated.
